name: io.github.sandeepbazar/ocm-mcp-server
description: Guardrailed fleet ops for AI agents: operate multi-cluster Kubernetes via an OCM hub with policy checks, human approval, and audit.

environmentVariables.name: KUBECONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the kubeconfig with the OCM hub context (and optional spoke contexts).

environmentVariables.name: OCM_MCP_HUB_CONTEXT
environmentVariables.description: Kubeconfig context name of the OCM hub cluster (defaults to the current context).

environmentVariables.name: OCM_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to disable the gated write path entirely (read-only fleet access).
